child_initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original Soulmonsters evolutionary family, a flagship partner creature with distinct living-kite anatomy. 45% expressive creature,45% FUNCTIONAL LIVING KITE body,10% authorial clean 2D manga and selective stepped outer contour. One creature, one fullbody threequarter hero pose on WHITE with ample margins. No text, other characters, pose duplicates, scenery or effects hiding body. Crisp strong dark line, vivid flat colors, ONE hard cel shadow, simple broad shapes, large quiet planes, NO airbrush/gradient/CGI, fur, noisy triangle tessellation, huge scale texture or ornament spam. Family palette vermilion/coral-orange body, midnight indigo structural surfaces, warm ivory belly/muzzle/fold interiors, small golden bamboo and amber eyes. Living folded tension-paper makes body volume, curved spars are anatomical edges, knot is an articulation; NOT real dinosaur wearing a kite backpack. NO patches, clothes, logos, heart symbols, named franchise designs or copied head/body silhouette. A continuous cord rabiola contains the creature's soul, never disconnected, ending in TWO flat chevron paper tabs (baby only ONE). Signature recurring features: broad rounded TRAPEZOID reptile muzzle with a crisp ivory lower face, offset ivory chevron on forehead not a letter or symbol copied from a franchise, TWO short swept INDIGO folded paper cheek-keels instead of horns/ears, a diagonal coral/ivory abdominal fold held by one small gold side-knot. No fire on tail, no dinosaur skull helmet, no swords, humanoid armor, wings added everywhere or magic orb. All limbs and roots readable.
CHILD pilot, provisional name Tramino. Compact biped living paper mini-reptile, NOT a T-rex/dragon copied from an existing monster. Big but angular wedge head, broad short trapezoid muzzle with defined nose plane, two tiny slit nostrils, warm almond AMBER manga eyes with alert brave curious expression, slight asymmetrical grin with ONE small visible triangular tooth. Brow fold has one offcenter ivory chevron and two distinct short swept indigo paper cheek-keels. Two small arms with THREE thick fingertips each and flat ivory claw tips; two sturdy bent legs with broad TWO-toed folded-paper feet, clear feet on floor. Two tiny triangular folded membranes grow continuously along forearm outer edges, not full wings, no backpack; slight extra space between arm and torso. Head about 40% body height, pear-shaped ivory belly, vermilion body, indigo forearms/heels. One simple diagonal fold across belly with gold knot at side, no chest logo. Short tapered rear fleshy-paper tail transitions into SINGLE gold cord rabiola with TWO indigo/ivory chevron tabs, root visible behind hip. Sideways playful forward step, one forepaw extended as if inviting player to follow. Iconic lovable companion with courage, restraint in detail, 45% actual kite construction. No long tall head horn, V forehead mark, black hazard emblem, fireball or allover blue mascot.
child_final_prompt: Create an original friendly fantasy companion creature concept for the game Soulmonsters, called Tramino (do not write the name in image). One complete creature in three-quarter view on white, clean 2D manga cel illustration, crisp dark outline and flat vivid colors. It is a small bipedal paper reptile whose actual body is made from living folded kite paper, not an ordinary animal wearing accessories. Vermilion/coral body, warm ivory trapezoid muzzle and belly, midnight indigo folds, tiny golden bamboo edges and amber eyes. Broad angular but welcoming face with short reptile muzzle, tiny nostrils, friendly asymmetrical grin and one discreet small tooth. One offset ivory forehead fold, two small swept indigo cheek-keels; no horns or tall ears. Two short arms with three blunt finger-claws, two bent sturdy legs with two broad toes, forearm folds form small triangular membranes continuously connected to anatomy. A diagonal belly fold held by one small gold knot at flank. A short rear tail transitions into a continuous gold cord with two ivory/indigo chevron paper tabs. Brave, curious, slightly impulsive personality, one forepaw reaching invitingly forward in an energetic step. Strong simple memorable silhouette, quiet color areas, one hard cel shadow, no textures, gradients or realistic rendering. Material balance: living creature and kite-paper equally important, with a little selective stepped contour. Generous margins, all tail tabs and feet visible. No writing, logo, scenery, duplicate poses, copied franchise features, costumes, armor, fire or weapons.

young_draft_prompt: Create an original fantasy creature concept for the game Soulmonsters: Tramassauro, the intermediate evolution of the attached own Tramino artwork. Vermilion and coral body, ivory muzzle/chest/diagonal belly fold, deep indigo forelegs and cheek-keels, a few warm golden bamboo edge spars and a gold knotted joint on the flank. A low swept ivory forehead fold inherits the small companion's crest. Each foreleg has a broad indigo/coral triangular tension-paper surface growing continuously from elbow to outer forearm, acting as a folded wind-brake and protective surface; these are part of its body. No extra wings or limbs. Four paws clearly visible and planted in a forward leaning protective stance, one forepaw extended to cover a passage. A short body tail transitions into an attached continuous gold cord with TWO ivory/indigo chevron tabs fully visible. Show substantial change from the upright small companion into an athletic four-legged creature that can intercept and support. Living creature and functional kite construction equally important. Clean original 2D manga cel art, dark crisp contours, flat saturated colors, single shadow tone, big simple surfaces without detailed textures, gradients or realistic rendering. No text, logos, scenery, weapons or duplicate poses.

adult_initial_prompt: An original mature fantasy living-paper dragon for Soulmonsters, the final natural evolution of the attached OWN Tramino. One majestic complete creature on white, 3/4 view with wide margins. Clean expressive 2D manga cel drawing, crisp dark outline, large flat vivid colors and one hard shadow, economical folds without realistic texture or tiny scales. Four strong grounded animal legs with three blunt ivory toes each, plus exactly TWO true dorsal kite-sail wings rooted behind the front shoulders. All four feet visible, no extra paws. Broad deep chest and elevated proud neck, compact tapering torso, midnight indigo main body, vermilion/coral outer limbs and huge wing surfaces, warm ivory long trapezoid muzzle and folded chest keel, amber eyes. Mature small head in relation to shoulders, defined nasal bridge, firm jaw, narrow confident amber eyes, ivory low swept forehead fold and two flat swept indigo cheek-keels; creature is regal and wise with a little familiar warmth. No helmet. The whole organism is living tension-paper: broad folded ventral membrane supports the chest, curved golden bamboo leading spars of wings visibly join shoulder structure and one golden knot at side recalls diagonal belly fold of the companion. One wing spread in a great sweeping triangular CORAL kite surface with broad IVORY negative fold and INDIGO leading rim, opposite wing partly folded; clear roots distinct from four legs. No feather wings or objects strapped to back. Powerful broad paws hold stance as the dragon prepares to sustain a corridor of wind so companions can follow. A short stout bodily tail transitions into attached gold soul-cord ending in TWO ivory/indigo chevron tabs, complete and visible. Meaningful transformation from little upright playful reptile into commanding kite-dragon, not just scaling up. No weapon, costume, spines all over, metal robot, scenery, aura, text or duplicate poses. Entire wings and feet inside image.
adult_final_prompt: A clean 2D manga concept illustration of an original majestic dragon made of living folded kite paper, standing in three-quarter view on a white background.
